raw_case_text:
A 3-year-and-8-month-old boy who had primary combined immunodeficiency [X-linked severe combined immunodeficiency in the 1L2RG gene (OMIM: 312863), and X-linked severe combined immunodeficiency highly associated mutation (OMIM: 300400)] and experienced interstitial pneumonia at 2 years of age was admitted to our hospital for fever, cough and difficulty breathing. He was also a full-term child, and there was no abnormality in his birth history. He had been admitted to local hospitals 11 times since his first admission for "interstitial pneumonia" in 2019. He was transferred to the PICU of our hospital with a diagnosis of severe pneumonia, respiratory failure and interstitial pneumonia. Nasopharyngeal swabs were collected the next day. Coarse breath sounds and moist rates were found in both lungs. Chest CT demonstrated diffuse parenchymal changes and small alveolar emphysema in both lungs ( Figure 1B ). Sputum specimen was positive for Pneumocystis. Other clinical results are shown in  Table 1 . Upon admission, cotrimoxazole and methylprednisolone were given immediately to control infection and relieve inflammation. Fourteen days later, fungal hyphae were found in the respiratory tract, and voriconazole was added. On Day 87, his dyspnoea increased, and mechanical ventilation was given. On the 98th day of admission, his transcutaneous oxygen saturation, heart rate, and blood pressure dropped severely, with spontaneous breathing and aorta pulsates disappearing. He finally died due to severe acute respiratory distress syndrome that developed from pneumonia.
Two complete genome sequences of 5,229 bp (BCH2008-1) and 5,228 bp (BCH2020_1) were identified after mapping 35,550 (29,374,647 reads in total; 0.12%) and 56,897 (37,864,592 reads in total; 0.15%) sequencing reads, respectively, against the 5,229-bp-long reference genome for WUPyV (GenBank accession no. NC_009539). The whole-genome sequences of two WUPyV strains have been deposited in GenBank under accession numbers MW338654 and MW338655. The alignment results of the two sequences with the reference sequence are shown in  Table 2 . For BCH2008-1, there was only one amino acid variant in the VP2 protein (Glu250Gly) alignment to NC_009539. For BCH2020_1, there were three variants separately located in VP1 (Ala82Thr), VP2 (Met324Ile), and large T antigen (Asn56Lys). All four variations were not unique for our cases. After summarizing all WUPyV complete sequences submitted to GenBank (149 in total), the incidence of variations found in our sequences is shown in  Table 2 .
Phylogenetic analyses were performed with 112 other WUPyV complete sequences submitted to GenBank, with all sequences derived from China (67 in total) and representative sequences from other countries (23 from Australia, 2 from Thailand, 5 from Germany, 3 from the Netherlands, 5 from Canada, 3 from Sweden, 3 from South Korea, and 1 from the USA). The results showed that three branches were formed, and the largest branch (I) was further divided into four clusters. The strains in Cluster Ib were mainly from Western countries, and strains from China were gathered in Cluster Ia, Cluster Ic, and Cluster IIIa. Our isolate BCH2020-1 grouped most closely with the strain in Cluster Ia: FZ18 (accession no. FJ890981.1), which was collected in 2013 from Fujian, China. BCH2008_1 grouped most closely with strain CQ5307 (accession no. KX034823.1), which was collected from Chongqing, China, in 2013 ( Figure 2 ).

subjective.chief_complaint: A 3-year-and-8-month-old boy with X-linked severe combined immunodeficiency (IL2RG mutation) and 11 prior hospitalizations for interstitial pneumonia presented with fever, cough, and difficulty breathing.
subjective.history_of_present_illness: Born full-term with an unremarkable birth history, the child had genetically confirmed X-linked severe combined immunodeficiency (IL2RG mutation) and had been hospitalized 11 times at local hospitals since age 2 (2019) for recurrent interstitial pneumonia. He was transferred to our PICU with fever, cough, severe dyspnea, and acute respiratory failure.
subjective.past_medical_history: X-linked severe combined immunodeficiency (X-SCID; IL2RG gene mutation, OMIM 312863 / 300400); 11 prior hospitalizations for interstitial pneumonia starting at 2 years of age; full-term birth.
subjective.review_of_systems: Positive for fever, cough, and severe difficulty breathing.

objective.physical_examination: Coarse breath sounds and moist rales auscultated across both lungs; progressive respiratory failure requiring invasive mechanical ventilation on hospital day 87, culminating in severe hypoxemia, bradycardia, hypotension, and cardiac arrest on day 98.
objective.routine_investigations: Sputum and respiratory tract microbiology: Admission sputum specimen positive for Pneumocystis; respiratory tract specimen on hospital day 14 positive for fungal hyphae.
objective.advanced_workup: Chest CT scan: Diffuse bilateral parenchymal infiltrates and small alveolar emphysema. Nasopharyngeal swab metagenomic sequencing and viral whole-genome assembly: Identified and assembled complete 5,228-bp genome sequences of WU polyomavirus (WUPyV strain BCH2020_1, GenBank MW338655; 56,897 reads, 0.15% of total reads, clustering in Chinese Cluster Ia with VP1 Ala82Thr, VP2 Met324Ile, and large T antigen Asn56Lys variants).

assessment_and_plan.assessment_and_confirmation: Final diagnosis: Fatal Pneumocystis pneumonia (confirmed on sputum examination), secondary filamentous fungal respiratory infection (day 14), and persistent WU polyomavirus (WUPyV strain BCH2020_1, GenBank MW338655) co-infection leading to severe acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) in a 3-year-8-month-old boy with X-linked severe combined immunodeficiency (IL2RG mutation). Plan and clinical course: Immediately treated on PICU admission with co-trimoxazole (TMP-SMX) and methylprednisolone, with voriconazole added on day 14 after fungal hyphae were detected in the respiratory tract, and invasive mechanical ventilation initiated on day 87; despite therapy, he died of refractory ARDS on hospital day 98.
